rationale.org-governance: policy-as-code, audit logging, accountability roles, maturity models across regulated orgs
rationale.oversight-theater: Scapegoat-as-a-Service: reviewers rubber-stamp probabilistic outputs lacking time/authority/evidence
rationale.provenance-auditability: MV-HIC evidence receipt, immutable audit log serving human reviewability
rationale.rules-based-checks: constraints evaluated by deterministic policy engine (OPA), externalized from model
rationale.hitl-workflow: humans define/enforce operating envelope, circuit breakers, approval gates, escalation
rationale.oversight-explanation: Intent/inputs/preview artifacts give reviewer verifiable evidence for escalation verdict
rationale.regulatory-compliance: translates EU AI Act Art.14, NIST RMF into engineering artifacts
rationale.counterpoint: opposes HITL-as-safety; argues it's performative liability transfer
rationale.design-only: MV-HIC specified in buildable detail; implementation deferred, no evaluation
rationale.framework: MV-HIC control-plane reference architecture, adoptable integration-layer design
rationale.general-ai: object is agentic actions (payments, clinical orders), not AI-generated code
rationale.agentic: AI-initiated tool-invoking consequential actions at payload granularity
rationale.risk-overreliance: over-reliance—automation bias, rubber-stamping under time pressure—focal harm mitigated
